question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses **the process of a substance integrating into a solvent to form a solution.**
 
• The **appropriate verb **should indicate the action of a substance** being incorporated into a liquid.**
 
• "**Dissolve**" fits well as it denotes the process of a solid becoming incorporated into a liquid to form a solution.
 
• Other options ("**evaporate**", "**melt**", "**diffuse**") do not fit the context of describing the integration of a substance into a solvent.

The correct sentence from the passage is ***"******Oil is almost certainly one of the ocean's greatest resources. 33% of the world's oil comes from seaward fields in seas. Oils are liquids that easily burn and do not dissolve__ in water."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Evaporate (वाष्पित होना): "Evaporate" **means to turn from liquid into vapor, which does not fit the context of dissolving a solid in a liquid.
 
• **Melt (पिघलना): "Melt"** means to make or become liquefied by heat, which does not reflect the process of forming a solution.
 
• **Diffuse (फैलना): "Diffuse" **means to spread over a wide area, which does not align with the idea of a solid integrating into a liquid.
